NOT preschool clay toys, not photorealistic, not a generic corporate illustration.

RIGHT 60 percent: an inviting exploration booth, a small transparent ticket allocation kiosk with simple blank glowing ticket shapes, a shared planning table, and four fictional Korean teenage students with varied everyday clothing: a girl with a short black bob and mint jacket, a boy with wavy dark hair and cream sweatshirt, a girl with long tied-back hair and apricot cardigan, a boy with short hair and violet overshirt. They are curious and discussing opportunities to participate, equal dignity. One considers a blank information card, another gestures toward a side entrance. Abstract festival lanterns overhead, thoughtful warm atmosphere.
LEFT 40 percent: generous calm dark indigo architectural surface and quiet evening sky, intentionally low-detail negative space for a large HTML title and two buttons. No fake UI, no built-in panels or controls. One continuous cinematic illustration, not a collage. Every sign and card blank: NO letters, numbers, words, logos, watermarks. Composition must remain usable as game landing background.
